First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it.
